message.content: I'll analyze this NTT kernel: the contract, the radix-4 fused butterfly structure, the Montgomery reduction, and the coefficient packing scheme, then record the description model.

function.arguments: {"contract_model": ["out[b,k] = sum_j x[b,j]*omega_N^(j*k) mod 3329 with omega_N = 17^(256/N) mod 3329, natural-order output k, no normalization, cyclic (not negacyclic) transform.", "Domain: int32 tensor, shape [B,N] with 1<=B<=128 and N in {64,128}, contiguous on CUDA, all values in canonical 0..3328; every such input is legal, no distribution restriction.", "Exact integer result required: tolerance 0/0, canonical representative in [0,3328], fresh output tensor on x.device.", "reference() is a direct modular DFT (int64 products/sums), accepts CPU; validate_inputs() enforces the full domain and is called by run()."], "kernel_model": ["Implements a radix-4 fused butterfly NTT in a single Triton program per row (grid = batch), N lanes in registers, tl.gather for in-register shuffles.", "Input loaded in bit-reversed order (lines 53-55); pairs of radix-2 stages fused into radix-4 stages: LOG_N//2 fused stages, plus one optional radix-2 last stage when LOG_N is odd (N=128 -> LOG_N=7 -> 3 radix-4 + 1 radix-2; N=64 -> LOG_N=6 -> 3 radix-4).", "Coefficients precomputed host-side in _make_coefficients as 5 banks per stage (first/second/upper/cross_low/cross_high) with Montgomery form _R = 2^16 residues; _R and _R_INV defined but only _R used.", "_multiply uses Montgomery-style reduction: product in int64, correction = (product*3327)&0xFFFF, reduced = (product + correction*3329)>>16, conditional subtract; assumes inputs are canonical values times Montgomery-form coefficients (coefficients carry the 2^16 factor, values are plain residues), so reduction yields plain residue.", "Intermediate values kept canonical by (value + 2*3329) % 3329 after each fused stage and (value+3329)%3329 after last stage; butterfly sums a±p±c±d computed in int32 before reduction.", "Bank indexing: start = 5*(half-1)//3 for fused stages and start = 5*((1<<(2*(LOG_N//2)))-1)//3 for the last stage; layout matches _make_coefficients's concatenation of 5*half entries per stage.", "validate_inputs enforces tensor type, contiguity, no view flags, CUDA, shape/dtype and canonical value range; run() allocates coefficients per call and launches with num_warps=4."], "open_questions": ["Does tl.gather(value, base, axis=0) with int32 index tensors behave as assumed in Triton 3.4.0 for these shapes?", "Is the fused radix-4 butterfly formula (a+p, second/upper weighting of c, cross_low/cross_high weighting of d, quadrant split 0..3) algebraically exact for the cyclic DFT with these twiddle placements?", "Does _make_coefficients' bank layout (5*half entries, packed sequentially) match the kernel's 'start = 5*(half-1)//3' and last-stage 'start' exactly for both N=64 and N=128?", "Does the Montgomery reduction in _multiply produce exact plain residues for all canonical value x coefficient-in-Montgomery-form products (max product ~ 3328 * 3328*2^16)?"], "risk_map": ["Coefficient bank indexing: 'start = 5*(half-1)//3' closed form must reproduce the sequential layout from _make_coefficients (stages of 5*half entries with half = 1,4,16); for half=1,4,16 the offsets are 0,5,25 = 5*(1+4+16)=5*(half-1)/3 only if (half-1)%3==0, which holds for powers of 4, but the last-stage start '5*((1<<(2*(LOG_N//2)))-1)//3' should be verified numerically.", "Montgomery reduction correctness: _multiply assumes exactly one 2^16 factor in the product (coefficient in Montgomery form, value plain). If any intermediate value were also in Montgomery form the result would be off by 2^16. Also check reduced can exceed 3329 and the conditional subtract handles the range (reduced in [0, 2*3329) roughly).", "Fused-butterfly algebra: the quadrant formulas (lower_sum/lower_difference/upper_sum/upper_difference with twiddles first/second/upper/cross_low/cross_high) must reproduce the exact DFT twiddle exponents omega^(j*width/(2*half)) etc.; an exponent-sign or permutation error would still pass for constant inputs.", "Gather semantics: tl.gather with base indices across lanes implements a per-lane lookup; the radix-4 index arithmetic (base, base+half, base+2*half, base+3*half with quadrant derived from lane//half & 3) must be consistent with the coefficient banks' j indices.", "Negative-value handling: lower_difference etc. can be negative before the +2*3329 wrap; verify int32 % in Triton matches Python mod for negatives.", "N=128 path exercises the odd-LOG_N last stage; N=64 does not, so both widths need separate evidence.", "Host-side _make_coefficients recomputed per run() call; any width-dependent bug (e.g., omega = 17^(256/width)) affects one width only."], "scope_notes": ["Only N in {64,128} and B in [1,128], int32, canonical field values, CUDA; anything else is rejected by validate_inputs and out of scope.", "Tolerance is exactly 0/0 against the integer DFT; any modular-equivalence shortcut that yields a different representative in [0,3328] is a failure.", "Frozen environment: NVIDIA T4, PyTorch 2.8.0, Triton 3.4.0; tl.gather and tl.static_range semantics of that version matter.", "Contiguous views with nonzero storage offsets are legal; kernel indexes via row*N + lane from data_ptr implicitly, which is fine for contiguous tensors."], "summary": "Described case_151: cyclic NTT mod 3329 via fused radix-4 butterflies with Montgomery-form coefficient banks in a single Triton kernel; identified coefficient-bank indexing, Montgomery reduction semantics, butterfly algebra, and width-specific code paths as the main bug surfaces."}
